name: Hybrid QSM-weighted T1 Generator
summary: Generates a hybrid contrast image (HC = w1 x T1w + w2 x QSM) from a T1-weighted image and a QSM map with nibabel, improving subcortical gray matter contrast.
description: Loads the T1w and QSM images, resamples the QSM to the T1 grid when shapes differ, and writes the weighted sum as a new T1w-type image. Use it to improve subcortical gray matter contrast before segmentation (e.g. FSL FIRST). The QSM map should be co-registered to the T1.

inputs.description: T1-weighted image; defines the output grid.
Quantitative susceptibility map of the same subject.
inputs.requirements: Must be aligned to the T1; it is resampled to the T1 grid if dimensions differ.

parameters.description: Weighting coefficient for the T1 image.
Weighting coefficient for the QSM image.
